title: FHIR Pseudonymizer
description: Throughput, anonymization and pseudonymization timings (also per resource), Kafka, REST API and .NET runtime/GC metrics of the FHIR Pseudonymizer.

panels.title: Resources / s
panels.description: FHIR resources processed per second, by Kafka and the REST API combined. A bundle counts as its number of entries, any other resource as one.

panels.title: Kafka messages / s
panels.description: Messages consumed from Kafka per second, whether they were produced to their output topic or dead-lettered.

panels.title: REST requests / s
panels.description: Requests to the FHIR operations ($de-identify, $de-pseudonymize) per second.

panels.title: Time per resource
panels.description: Average time the anonymization engine spends per resource: its total processing time divided by the number of resources it processed. Comparable across bundle sizes.

panels.title: Time per resource p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time per resource: of all resources and bundles processed, 95% took at most this long per resource they contain.

panels.title: Waiting for pseudonyms
panels.description: Share of the anonymization engine's time spent waiting for the pseudonymization service (pseudonyms not found in the cache). Close to 100%: throughput is limited by the pseudonymization service, or the cache hit ratio. Close to 0%: by this service's own CPU.

panels.title: Pseudonym cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of pseudonym lookups answered from the in-memory cache, without calling the pseudonymization service.

panels.title: Pseudonym service p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time the pseudonymization service took to answer a successful lookup, including the client's own retries.

panels.title: Failed in time range
panels.description: Kafka messages that were dead-lettered or could not be handled at all, plus REST requests answered with a 5xx status or 422 (pseudonymization service rejected a value), within the selected time range.

targets.expr: (clamp_min(sum(fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome!="success"}) - sum(fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome!="success"} offset $__range), 0) or sum(fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome!="success"}) or vector(0)) + (clamp_min(sum(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"(?i)fhir/.*", http_response_status_code=~"5..|422"}) - sum(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"(?i)fhir/.*", http_response_status_code=~"5..|422"} offset $__range), 0) or sum(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"(?i)fhir/.*", http_response_status_code=~"5..|422"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag
panels.description: Messages in the input topics not yet consumed by the selected consumer group. Requires a Kafka exporter (e.g. danielqsj/kafka-exporter, or kminion with the same metric names) scraped by the same Prometheus.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU time used by this service, relative to the CPUs available to it, across the selected instances.

panels.title: GC pause
panels.description: Share of time the runtime paused all threads for garbage collection, averaged across the selected instances. Above a few percent, allocations are worth reducing - see the runtime row.

panels.title: Resources processed
panels.description: Resources processed per second by the anonymization engine, by where they came from and the operation applied. A bundle counts as its number of entries.

panels.title: Duration per resource or bundle
panels.description: Time the anonymization engine took to process a single resource or a whole bundle, including waiting for the pseudonymization service, but not parsing or serializing it. Depends on the bundle sizes - see the time per resource for a comparable measure.

panels.title: Time per resource
panels.description: Processing time normalized by the number of resources in each bundle. 'avg' weighs every resource the same (total time / total resources); the percentiles are over the processed resources and bundles, each with its own time per contained resource.

targets.expr: sum by (source) (rate(fhirpseudonymizer_anonymization_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (source) (rate(fhirpseudonymizer_anonymization_resources_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Where the time per resource goes
panels.description: Average time per resource, split into waiting for the pseudonymization service and everything else the anonymization engine does (evaluating the FHIRPath rules, hashing, redacting, ...), which is mostly CPU. Excludes parsing, serializing and producing.

panels.title: Resources per message
panels.description: How many resources each processed resource or bundle contained (1 for anything but a bundle): the average, and the 95th percentile.

panels.title: Time per resource distribution
panels.description: How the time per resource is distributed over time. Each cell counts the resources and bundles whose time per contained resource falls into that bucket.

panels.title: Failed anonymizations
panels.description: Resources and bundles per minute the anonymization engine failed to process, e.g. since the pseudonymization service was unavailable or rejected a value. Kafka retries the former, so the same message may fail more than once.

targets.expr: (clamp_min(sum by (source, operation) (fhirpseudonymizer_anonymization_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"}) - sum by (source, operation) (fhirpseudonymizer_anonymization_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"} offset $__interval), 0) or sum by (source, operation) (fhirpseudonymizer_anonymization_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"})) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

panels.title: Pseudonym lookups
panels.description: Pseudonyms (or original values) looked up per second, and how many of those were not in the cache, so had to be requested from the pseudonymization service.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups answered from the in-memory cache. Its size and expiration are set by Cache__SizeLimit, Cache__SlidingExpirationMinutes and Cache__AbsoluteExpirationMinutes.

panels.title: Pseudonymization service latency
panels.description: Time the pseudonymization service took to answer a successful lookup, including the client's own retries.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, operation) (rate(fhirpseudonymizer_pseudonymization_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) (rate(fhirpseudonymizer_pseudonymization_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation) (rate(fhirpseudonymizer_pseudonymization_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Requests by outcome
panels.description: Requests to the pseudonymization service per second, by outcome. 'transient': unavailable even after the client's retries - Kafka messages are retried later, REST requests answered with 503. 'rejected': the service refused the value - dead-lettered, or 422.

panels.title: Concurrent requests
panels.description: Average number of requests to the pseudonymization service in flight at once, compared to how many could be: one per Kafka consumer with assigned partitions, plus one per REST request in flight. When both lines meet, every worker is waiting on the pseudonymization service.

targets.expr: (count(fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_partitions_assigned{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} > 0) or vector(0)) + (sum(http_server_active_requests{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Lookups per resource
panels.description: Pseudonym lookups per processed resource, in total and those that missed the cache. Depends on the anonymization rules and the data.

panels.title: HTTP and gRPC calls by host and status
panels.description: Outgoing HTTP calls, which includes the pseudonymization service (gRPC for Vfps) and token endpoints. Unlike the panels above, every retry counts as a call of its own.

panels.title: Messages by topic and outcome
panels.description: Messages consumed per second, by input topic and how they were handled.

panels.title: Consumer lag
panels.description: Messages not yet consumed, by topic, for the selected consumer group. Requires a Kafka exporter scraped by the same Prometheus.

panels.title: Message latency
panels.description: Time from consuming a message to the broker acknowledging its pseudonymized version (or its dead-lettered original), including parsing, anonymizing, serializing, and the producer's batching delay (Kafka__Producer__LingerMs).

panels.title: Partitions per instance
panels.description: Partitions assigned to each instance's consumers, and those paused while one of their messages waits to be retried after the pseudonymization service was unavailable.

panels.title: Retried and failed messages
panels.description: Messages per minute that only succeeded after being retried, were sent to their dead letter topic, or could not even be dead-lettered (then consumed again later).

targets.expr: (clamp_min(sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_message_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", attempts!="1", outcome="success"}) - sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_message_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", attempts!="1", outcome="success"} offset $__interval), 0) or sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_message_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", attempts!="1", outcome="success"})) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

(clamp_min(sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="dead-lettered"}) - sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="dead-lettered"} offset $__interval), 0) or sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="dead-lettered"})) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

(clamp_min(sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"}) - sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"} offset $__interval), 0) or sum by (topic) (fhirpseudonymizer_kafka_messages_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome="error"})) / ($__interval_ms / 60000)

panels.title: Requests by route and status
panels.description: Requests per second to the FHIR operations, by route and response status. 422: the pseudonymization service rejected a value; 499: the caller went away; 503: the pseudonymization service was unavailable.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: Time to answer a request, including reading and parsing the request body and writing the response.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests being processed, and connections Kestrel accepted but hasn't started processing yet (a sign of thread pool starvation or connection limits).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per instance, and how many are available to it (dashed).

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Share of time each instance's threads were paused for garbage collection.

panels.title: GC collections
panels.description: Garbage collections per second, by the highest generation collected. Frequent gen2 collections are expensive, and usually caused by large object heap (LOH) allocations, such as large bundles.

panels.title: Heap size after last GC
panels.description: Size of each GC generation's heap after the most recent garbage collection, across the selected instances.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Bytes allocated on the managed heap per second, per instance. Allocations drive how often the GC has to run.

panels.title: Allocated per resource
panels.description: Bytes allocated per processed resource - by everything, including parsing, serializing, and the Kafka and HTTP clients. Comparable across load levels and bundle sizes.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set of the process, memory committed by the GC, and the fragmented (free but not reusable) part of the heap after the last collection.

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: Thread pool threads, and work items queued for them. A growing queue with a rising thread count indicates thread pool starvation, e.g. by blocking calls.

panels.title: Lock contention and exceptions
panels.description: Times per second a thread had to wait for a lock held by another one, and exceptions thrown per second, by type.
